授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）:

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: Inorganic chemistry concerns more than 100 elements in the periodic table. General trends in the table can be understood by the structure of atoms and their electronic state. In this course, students learn basic concept and fundamental idea on atomic structure, molecular orbitals, crystalline solid, acid and base, and oxidation and reduction.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Bohr model of hydrogen atom, molecular orbital, electronic structure, ionic bond, covalent bond, crystalline solid, acid and base, oxidation and reduction, electrochemistry
